result.detail:
Decisions to record:
(1) No formal_spec is submitted. The task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench only, so the SymbiYosys jobs that section 6 of the microarchitecture plans (sync_fifo.sby and sync_fifo_depth5.sby) are left to a formal task. The ifdef FORMAL block in the RTL is design intent only. It omits the pointer-distance invariant and the property for a slot chosen by the solver, which an unbounded proof will need. These are deviations from the verification plan and are recorded here so they are not silent.
(2) sync_fifo_tb_fail.v, the negative-path testbench, is not delivered. The simulator takes its top from the first testbench file only.
(3) Widths are derived from localparam integer copies of the parameters through part-selects, to avoid width warnings in Verilator -Wall.
(4) The testbench drives and checks on the falling edge and updates its models after the rising edge. It uses a deterministic xorshift generator so that results are reproducible across simulators.
